create.title: Create a new blog
create.titleHint: If left empty, the title is based on your nickname.
create.limitReached: You've reached your blog limit and can't create more.

delete.warning: This can't be undone. All posts in this blog will be hidden, and no one can use this address again.

withdraw.warning: This can't be undone. You won't be able to log in, and all posts in all your blogs will become private. Your personal information will be destroyed after 30 days.
